title: 科研 ML 六问前置校验
description: 在建模之前用六个问题（目标/样本/表示/规模/先验/交付）检查科研 ML 任务的方法前提；输出缺项、红旗、必检项、候选模型族与结论。红旗是启发式，不替代验证。

goal_type.description: 科学目标与任务类型（你怎么使用答案）

task_use.description: 答案给谁用、用来做什么（自由文本）

n_eff.description: 有效独立样本数（不是文件行数）

leakage.description: 可能存在的同源泄漏（可多选）

structure.description: 必须保留的数据结构（可多选）

quality.description: 已知数据质量问题（可多选）

prior.description: 已知科学先验（没有就选 none_known）

rules.condition: state.get('goal_type') is None
rules.description: 缺少第1问：科学目标与任务类型

evidence.note: 完整性门控：缺项优先于红黄灯；缺项不清不谈模型

params.value: 第1问：科学目标与任务类型

rules.condition: state.get('metric') is None

evidence.note: 完整性门控：没有指标就没有可比性

params.value: 第1问：评价指标

rules.condition: state.get('sample_unit') is None
rules.description: 缺少第2问：样本与独立单位

evidence.note: 完整性门控：样本单位决定切分方式

params.value: 第2问：一个样本与独立单位

rules.condition: state.get('n_eff') is None
rules.description: 缺少第2问：有效样本量 N

evidence.note: 完整性门控：有效 N 不是行数

params.value: 第2问：有效样本量 N

rules.condition: state.get('modality') is None

evidence.note: 完整性门控：模态决定表示

params.value: 第3问：数据模态

rules.condition: state.get('label_ratio') is None

evidence.note: 完整性门控：标签比例决定监督是否可行

params.value: 第4问：标签比例

rules.condition: state.get('prior') is None

evidence.note: 完整性门控：先验决定模型结构

params.value: 第5问：科学先验（没有就选 none_known）

rules.condition: state.get('delivery') is None

evidence.note: 完整性门控：交付要求决定指标与不确定性

params.value: 第6问：交付要求

rules.condition: state.get('goal_type') == 'ranking' and (state.get('metric') == 'rmse' or state.get('metric') == 'mae')
rules.description: 排序任务用了回归指标

evidence.note: 排序任务应使用 Recall@k / NDCG 等排序度量

params.value: 排序任务用了 RMSE/MAE：它们不反映前 k 名是否抓对
改用 Recall@k 或 NDCG，并先定义 k

rules.condition: state.get('n_eff') is not None and state.get('n_eff') < 100 and (state.get('baseline') == 'cnn' or state.get('baseline') == 'rnn' or state.get('baseline') == 'gnn' or state.get('baseline') == 'transformer')

evidence.note: 容量-数据匹配经验；阈值 N<100 未校准

params.value: N<100 却直接上 CNN/RNN/GNN/Transformer：容量与数据不匹配
先跑线性/树 baseline；或换先验更强、参数更少的模型

rules.condition: state.get('leakage') is not None and 'same_system' in state.get('leakage')

evidence.note: 组泄漏：同体系样本跨训练/测试集

params.value: 同一体系/成分族的样本跨训练与测试：指标可能是同源泄漏
按体系整组切分，再统计有效 N

rules.condition: state.get('leakage') is not None and 'same_batch' in state.get('leakage')

evidence.note: 批次效应：同批次样本跨集

params.value: 同一实验批次的样本跨集：批次效应会被当成模型能力
按批次整组切分，并做跨批次验证

rules.condition: state.get('leakage') is not None and 'same_field' in state.get('leakage')
rules.description: 同视场/同对象样本跨集

evidence.note: 对象/视场级泄漏：同一对象的切片跨集

params.value: 同一视场/同一对象的多个切片跨集：模型可能只认出了对象
按对象/视场整组切分

rules.condition: state.get('leakage') is not None and 'preprocess_full' in state.get('leakage')

evidence.note: 预处理泄漏：缩放/填充/特征选择用全量数据

params.value: 缩放/填充/特征选择用了全量数据：验证集信息泄漏进训练
预处理规则只在训练集拟合，再应用到验证/测试

rules.condition: (state.get('goal_type') == 'regression' or state.get('goal_type') == 'classification' or state.get('goal_type') == 'ranking') and (state.get('label_ratio') == 'few' or state.get('label_ratio') == 'none')

evidence.note: 标签不足时改任务，或半监督/主动学习/迁移

params.value: 监督任务但标签比例是 few/none：当前数据不足以支撑监督学习
先解决标签：主动学习/弱监督/迁移学习，或改任务

rules.condition: state.get('goal_type') == 'classification' and state.get('quality') is not None and 'imbalance' in state.get('quality')

evidence.note: 不平衡分类用 PR 曲线/AUC 与代价敏感指标

params.value: 用 PR 曲线/AUC 与代价敏感指标，不看准确率

rules.condition: state.get('prior') is not None and 'symmetry' in state.get('prior') and (state.get('baseline') == 'transformer' or state.get('baseline') == 'cnn' or state.get('baseline') == 'rnn')
rules.description: 有对称先验却用普通网络

evidence.note: 对称先验应进入模型结构（等变网络）

params.value: 明知有旋转/平移对称，却用普通 CNN/RNN/Transformer：先验没有进入模型
改用等变网络，或把对称写进数据表示/增强/约束

rules.condition: state.get('prior') is not None and ('conservation' in state.get('prior') or 'mechanism' in state.get('prior')) and state.get('baseline') != 'pinn'

evidence.note: 守恒/机理先验可用 PINN 或机理代理

params.value: 把守恒/机理写成约束损失（PINN）或机理+MLP 代理

rules.condition: state.get('delivery') is not None and 'explanation' in state.get('delivery') and (state.get('baseline') == 'cnn' or state.get('baseline') == 'rnn' or state.get('baseline') == 'gnn' or state.get('baseline') == 'transformer')
rules.description: 要可解释但候选是黑箱

evidence.note: 可解释交付与黑箱冲突；未校准

params.value: 交付要求可解释，但候选是黑箱：结论无法逐条解释
加解释/校准，或改用可解释基线（线性/树/机理）

rules.condition: state.get('quality') is not None and ('missing' in state.get('quality') or 'duplicate' in state.get('quality') or 'outlier' in state.get('quality'))

evidence.note: 数据卡：记录缺失/异常/去重规则及其影响

params.value: 数据卡记录缺失/异常/去重规则，并说明处理对结论的影响

rules.condition: state.get('delivery') is not None and 'uncertainty' in state.get('delivery')

evidence.note: 不确定度需报告并检查校准

params.value: 报告不确定度（置信区间/分位数/集成方差），并检查校准

rules.condition: state.get('delivery') is not None and 'extrapolation' in state.get('delivery')

evidence.note: 外推需单独外推集与适用域声明

params.value: 单独划外推集，写明适用域与超出后的处理

rules.condition: state.get('delivery') is not None and 'alarm' in state.get('delivery')

evidence.note: 失败报警阈值需按场景定义；未校准

params.value: 定义失败信号与报警阈值（输入越界/不确定度过大/分布漂移）

rules.condition: state.get('baseline') is None or state.get('baseline') == 'none'

evidence.note: 先建最小 baseline，再谈升级

params.value: 先建立最小 baseline（表格先线性/树），再谈升级

rules.condition: state.get('prior') is not None and 'symmetry' in state.get('prior') and state.get('modality') is not None and 'pointcloud' in state.get('modality')

evidence.note: 3D/点云需处理旋转、平移、排列不变性

params.value: 3D/点云要处理旋转、平移、排列不变性，优先等变网络

rules.condition: state.get('data_source') == 'literature' and state.get('quality') is not None and 'measurement_error' in state.get('quality')

evidence.note: 跨文献数据按来源分层验证；报告测量误差与异质性

params.value: 跨文献数据要报告测量误差与来源异质性，按来源分层验证

rules.condition: state.get('modality') is not None and 'graph' in state.get('modality') and state.get('structure') is not None and 'topology' in state.get('structure')

evidence.note: 图结构+拓扑 -> GNN；非排行榜；未校准

params.value: GNN（图神经网络）

rules.condition: state.get('modality') is not None and 'image' in state.get('modality') and state.get('structure') is not None and 'neighborhood' in state.get('structure')

evidence.note: 图像+邻域 -> CNN/预训练；非排行榜；未校准

params.value: CNN / 预训练视觉模型

rules.condition: state.get('modality') is not None and 'sequence' in state.get('modality') and state.get('structure') is not None and 'order' in state.get('structure')

evidence.note: 序列+顺序 -> RNN/TCN/Transformer；非排行榜；未校准

params.value: RNN / TCN / Transformer

rules.condition: state.get('modality') is not None and 'pointcloud' in state.get('modality') and state.get('prior') is not None and 'symmetry' in state.get('prior')
rules.description: 点云+对称 → 等变网络

evidence.note: 点云+对称 -> 等变网络；非排行榜；未校准

params.value: 等变网络 / 点云网络

rules.condition: state.get('modality') is not None and 'spatiotemporal' in state.get('modality')

evidence.note: 时空场 -> CNN+RNN/神经算子；非排行榜；未校准

params.value: CNN+RNN / 神经算子

rules.condition: state.get('modality') is not None and 'table' in state.get('modality') and state.get('n_eff') is not None and state.get('n_eff') < 1000

evidence.note: 小表格 -> 线性/树；阈值 1000 未校准

params.value: 线性回归 / 树模型（GBDT）

rules.condition: state.get('modality') is not None and 'table' in state.get('modality') and state.get('n_eff') is not None and state.get('n_eff') >= 1000

evidence.note: 大表格 -> GBDT/MLP；阈值 1000 未校准

params.value: 树模型（GBDT）/ MLP

rules.condition: state.get('prior') is not None and ('mechanism' in state.get('prior') or 'conservation' in state.get('prior'))
rules.description: 机理/守恒 → PINN/机理代理

evidence.note: 机理/守恒 -> PINN/机理代理；未校准

params.value: PINN / 机理+MLP 代理

rules.condition: state.get('modality') is not None and 'pointcloud' in state.get('modality')

evidence.note: 点云 -> 点云网络；非排行榜；未校准

params.value: 点云网络（PointNet 类）

rules.condition: state.get('modality') is not None and 'graph' in state.get('modality') and (state.get('structure') is None or (state.get('structure') is not None and 'topology' not in state.get('structure')))
rules.description: 图但拓扑未保留 → 图统计+树

evidence.note: 裁决顺序：缺项 -> 不出结论

params.value: 信息不足：先补六问
补齐缺失项后重跑；不要先跑模型

rules.condition: state.get('missing_inputs') is None and state.get('red_flags') is not None and state.get('verdict') is None

evidence.note: 裁决顺序：红旗 -> 先处理再升级

params.value: 有红旗：先处理，别调参
按必检项逐条处理后重跑；红旗未清零前不升级模型

rules.condition: state.get('missing_inputs') is None and state.get('red_flags') is None and state.get('verdict') is None

evidence.note: 裁决顺序：无缺项无红旗 -> 进入基线；'升级需三条判据' 的定义待补
